title: BAC-4412: One org-admin check for the bank account list
author: kate-zublenko
body:
Extracts `_is_org_admin` so `get_queryset` and the balance column ask one question.

Jira: https://hoopit.atlassian.net/browse/BAC-4412

comments.body: Finance asked last week for sub-group admins to see the balance of accounts that only their own groups use. If that's coming, `_is_org_admin` is the wrong question for the balance column and we'd want a separate `_can_view_balance` again. @lars-dahl owns that call, and he's back Monday. Don't change anything for it yet; leave this thread open until he answers.

reviews.body:
**Actionable comments posted: 0**

No new findings; the earlier ones are addressed.
